tagline: Leading operator of critical illness recovery hospitals, rehabilitation hospitals, and outpatient rehabilitation clinics
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue is the primary indicator of the company's size and growth within the healthcare services sector. It reflects the company's ability to deliver recovery and rehabilitation services to a broad patient base across the United States.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated revenue generated by all of the company's operations.
kpis.description: Total revenue represents the total amount of service sales generated by the company during the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA is a measure of operational performance that excludes certain non-cash and non-recurring items.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in adjusted operating profitability.

kpis.name: Critical Illness Hospitals Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by hospitals specializing in the recovery of patients with critical illnesses.
kpis.description: This segment represents the largest portion of the company's revenue.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in the core segment, representing 45% of revenue.

kpis.name: Rehabilitation Hospitals Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by hospitals providing intensive rehabilitation care.
kpis.description: This segment shows significant growth momentum.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in the rehabilitation segment, representing 24% of revenue.

kpis.name: Outpatient Clinics Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by clinics offering physical, occupational, and speech therapy rehabilitation services.
kpis.description: This segment contributes significantly to overall revenue.
kpis.signal: Stable growth in outpatient clinic revenue, representing 24% of revenue.

kpis.name: Medicare Revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue derived from services provided to patients covered under the Medicare program.
kpis.description: The Medicare program is a significant revenue source for the company, representing 31% of revenue in 2025.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in dependence on the Medicare program.

risks.title: Medicare Regulation and Changes in Payment Reconciliation Criteria
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to significant regulatory changes, such as modifications to payment reconciliation criteria for LTCHs, which may impact its revenue and operating results.

risks.title: Dependence on Medicare Payments

risks.title: Goodwill
